How much do treatments cost at SOLAR Sobha Hartland?

Prices at SOLAR are set per treatment and per plan. For medical and device treatments the doctor names the full price at the free consultation, before anything is booked.

What changes the price

  • Treatment: injectables, laser and device procedures use different products and consumables.
  • Zone and volume: a single zone costs less than a full face or a large body area.
  • Number of sessions: laser hair removal, RF microneedling and body treatments work as courses.
  • Single visit or a course: a planned course is normally more economical than booking sessions one at a time.

There are no hidden extras: the consultation is free and the price is agreed with you before the treatment starts.
